$comment: Register of regulated / legal / identity claims in the site copy. A claim may only become `approved` after the CLIENT has approved the wording AND supplied documentary evidence. Evidence is referenced here (issuer, document id, date, sha256 of the file you keep outside the repo); it is never committed. `bun scripts/check-compliance-copy.ts --strict` fails the release while anything is not approved.

claims.claim: SAHPRA Section 21 authorisation ("SAHPRA Section 21 Authorised", "one of a select few SAHPRA-authorised dispensaries")
claims.needs: SAHPRA Section 21 authorisation letter naming the legal entity, in date, covering the activity described (dispensing)

claims.claim: Company registration number 2026/047873/07 and legal name Canna Plug (Pty) Ltd
claims.needs: CIPC registration certificate (CoR14.3) for the exact number and name

claims.claim: "Licensed medical cannabis dispensary" / "operating in full compliance with South African law"
claims.needs: Legal sign-off on the wording plus the licence/permit documents it relies on

claims.claim: Lab-testing claims ("every batch is lab tested for cannabinoid content, potency and contaminants", "Lab tested" badges)
claims.needs: Certificates of analysis from an accredited lab for each product line, and a written testing policy

claims.claim: Contact telephone number +27 68 291 2107 (supplied by the owner on 2026-10-02 to replace the earlier dummy number)
claims.needs: Written confirmation from the client that this is the live support line

claims.claim: Physical address (Shop 002, One On Mutual, Pretoria Central) and trading hours
claims.needs: Lease / proof of premises and the client's confirmation of trading hours

locations.snippet: Shop 002, One On Mutual, Pretoria Central
Shop 002, One On Mutual, Pretoria Central

claims.claim: Banking details shown to customers for EFT (FNB / RMB, account 63210843975, branch 250655)
claims.needs: Bank-issued confirmation letter for the account (name, number, branch) — a wrong number sends customer money to the wrong place

claims.claim: Medical-recommendation and age statements ("some products require a valid medical practitioner recommendation", 18+, ID check on delivery)
claims.needs: Legal sign-off on wording; confirmation of which products need a recommendation

claims.claim: Delivery coverage, fees and handover rules; refund and returns terms
claims.needs: Client approval of commercial terms; legal review of consumer-law compliance (CPA)

claims.claim: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (POPIA information officer named and reachable)
claims.needs: Legal sign-off on both documents and the information officer's registration with the Information Regulator

claims.claim: Responsible-consumption notice shown from the footer, worded as following South African law and SAHPRA requirements
claims.needs: Client / regulatory-adviser sign-off on the wording, with the source document it is based on

locations.snippet: It follows the requirements of South African law and SAHPRA.
